agent_events_aggregate_identity_check.name: agent_events_aggregate_identity_check
agent_events_aggregate_identity_check.value: ("agent_events"."aggregate_type" = 'agent' AND "agent_events"."aggregate_id" = "agent_events"."agent_id" AND "agent_events"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_events"."aggregate_type" = 'orchestrator' AND "agent_events"."aggregate_id" = "agent_events"."orchestrator_id" AND "agent_events"."orchestrator_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_events"."aggregate_type" = 'task' AND "agent_events"."aggregate_id" = "agent_events"."task_id" AND "agent_events"."task_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_events"."aggregate_type" = 'execution' AND "agent_events"."aggregate_id" = "agent_events"."execution_id" AND "agent_events"."execution_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_events"."aggregate_type" = 'collaboration' AND "agent_events"."aggregate_id" = "agent_events"."collaboration_id" AND "agent_events"."collaboration_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_events"."delegation_id" IS NULL) OR ("agent_events"."aggregate_type" = 'delegation' AND "agent_events"."aggregate_id" = "agent_events"."delegation_id" AND "agent_events"."delegation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_events"."collaboration_id" IS NOT NULL)

agent_events_reference_presence_check.name: agent_events_reference_presence_check
agent_events_reference_presence_check.value: ("agent_events"."task_id" IS NULL OR ("agent_events"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_events"."orchestrator_id" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("agent_events"."execution_id" IS NULL OR "agent_events"."task_id" IS NOT NULL)

collaboration_delegations_identity_check.name: collaboration_delegations_identity_check
collaboration_delegations_identity_check.value: "collaboration_delegations"."source_agent_id" <> "collaboration_delegations"."target_agent_id" AND ("collaboration_delegations"."child_task_id" IS NULL OR "collaboration_delegations"."child_task_id" <> "collaboration_delegations"."parent_task_id") AND ("collaboration_delegations"."continuation_task_id" IS NULL OR ("collaboration_delegations"."continuation_task_id" <> "collaboration_delegations"."parent_task_id" AND "collaboration_delegations"."continuation_task_id" <> "collaboration_delegations"."child_task_id"))

collaboration_delegations_reference_chec.name: collaboration_delegations_reference_check
collaboration_delegations_reference_chec.value: ("collaboration_delegations"."child_execution_id" IS NULL OR "collaboration_delegations"."child_task_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("collaboration_delegations"."continuation_execution_id" IS NULL OR "collaboration_delegations"."continuation_task_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("collaboration_delegations"."continuation_task_id" IS NULL OR "collaboration_delegations"."child_task_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("collaboration_delegations"."status" NOT IN ('ACCEPTED','EXECUTING','AWAITING_RETURN','COMPLETED') OR "collaboration_delegations"."child_task_id" IS NOT NULL)

collaboration_delegations_time_check.name: collaboration_delegations_time_check
collaboration_delegations_time_check.value: "collaboration_delegations"."version" > 0 AND "collaboration_delegations"."updated_at" >= "collaboration_delegations"."created_at" AND ("collaboration_delegations"."finished_at" IS NULL OR "collaboration_delegations"."finished_at" >= "collaboration_delegations"."created_at") AND (("collaboration_delegations"."status" IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED','REJECTED','EXPIRED')) = ("collaboration_delegations"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL))

collaboration_sessions_time_check.name: collaboration_sessions_time_check
collaboration_sessions_time_check.value: "collaboration_sessions"."version" > 0 AND "collaboration_sessions"."updated_at" >= "collaboration_sessions"."created_at" AND ("collaboration_sessions"."finished_at" IS NULL OR "collaboration_sessions"."finished_at" >= "collaboration_sessions"."created_at") AND (("collaboration_sessions"."status" IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')) = ("collaboration_sessions"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL))

command_audit_names_check.name: command_audit_names_check
command_audit_names_check.value: length("command_audit"."actor_reference") BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND length("command_audit"."command_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length("command_audit"."resource_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 64

executions_start_check.name: executions_start_check
executions_start_check.value: ("executions"."status" NOT IN ('RUNNING','SUCCEEDED') OR "executions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("executions"."status" <> 'PENDING' OR "executions"."started_at" IS NULL)

executions_timestamps_check.name: executions_timestamps_check
executions_timestamps_check.value: "executions"."updated_at" >= "executions"."created_at" AND ("executions"."started_at" IS NULL OR "executions"."started_at" >= "executions"."created_at") AND ("executions"."finished_at" IS NULL OR "executions"."finished_at" >= coalesce("executions"."started_at","executions"."created_at")) AND ("executions"."deadline_at" IS NULL OR "executions"."deadline_at" >= "executions"."created_at")

executions_lease_check.name: executions_lease_check
executions_lease_check.value: ("executions"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "executions"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "executions"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("executions"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "executions"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "executions"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

executions_error_check.name: executions_error_check
executions_error_check.value: ("executions"."error_code" IS NULL OR length("executions"."error_code") <= 128) AND ("executions"."error_message" IS NULL OR length("executions"."error_message") <= 2000) AND ("executions"."result_reference" IS NULL OR length("executions"."result_reference") BETWEEN 1 AND 512)

external_execution_mappings_values_check.name: external_execution_mappings_values_check
external_execution_mappings_values_check.value: length("external_execution_mappings"."external_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND "external_execution_mappings"."version" > 0 AND "external_execution_mappings"."status" IN ('UNKNOWN','QUEUED','RUNNING','COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND ("external_execution_mappings"."source_status" IS NULL OR length("external_execution_mappings"."source_status") BETWEEN 1 AND 256) AND ("external_execution_mappings"."sequence" IS NULL OR "external_execution_mappings"."sequence" ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,39})$') AND (("external_execution_mappings"."sequence" IS NULL) = ("external_execution_mappings"."sequence_domain" IS NULL)) AND ("external_execution_mappings"."delegation_id" IS NULL OR "external_execution_mappings"."collaboration_id" IS NOT NULL)

external_event_inbox_values_check.name: external_event_inbox_values_check
external_event_inbox_values_check.value: length("external_event_inbox"."event_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND "external_event_inbox"."content_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND jsonb_typeof("external_event_inbox"."event") = 'object' AND octet_length("external_event_inbox"."event"::text) <= 16384 AND "external_event_inbox"."status" IN ('PENDING','APPLIED','STALE','OBSERVED','DEFERRED_MAPPING','DEFERRED_ORDERING','DEFERRED_CONFLICT')

external_sources_values_check.name: external_sources_values_check
external_sources_values_check.value: "external_sources"."generation" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 AND "external_sources"."namespace" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$' AND "external_sources"."adapter_type" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$' AND ("external_sources"."ordering_domain" IS NULL OR "external_sources"."ordering_domain" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$')

tasks_idempotency_check.name: tasks_idempotency_check
tasks_idempotency_check.value: ("tasks"."idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "tasks"."request_hash" IS NULL) OR (length(btrim("tasks"."idempotency_key")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND "tasks"."request_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "tasks"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."request_hash" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_timestamps_check.name: tasks_timestamps_check
tasks_timestamps_check.value: "tasks"."updated_at" >= "tasks"."created_at" AND ("tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "tasks"."completed_at" >= "tasks"."created_at") AND ("tasks"."deadline_at" IS NULL OR "tasks"."deadline_at" >= "tasks"."created_at") AND ("tasks"."cancel_requested_at" IS NULL OR "tasks"."cancel_requested_at" >= "tasks"."created_at")
